items.title: Capture provenance and change ownership
items.candidate_progress: Protected branch, HEAD, dirty ownership and scratch source copies recorded.
items.remaining_acceptance: Review ownership map before any staging or branch operation.

items.title: Review and reproduce the reference
items.candidate_progress: Reference solver reproduced; pre-existing aerodynamic failures reproduced independently.
items.remaining_acceptance: Complete reference review and preserve baseline failure attribution.

items.title: Freeze mass and collision ownership contracts
items.candidate_progress: Mass perimeter and Rust contact ownership contracts recorded.
items.remaining_acceptance: Approve contracts after integrated owner verification.

items.title: Define quantitative validation budgets
items.candidate_progress: Quantitative validation specification recorded.
items.remaining_acceptance: Execute every specified gate against the integrated runtime.

items.title: Extend the versioned physical inventory
items.candidate_progress: Version 2 component schema, attachment validation, uncertainty and closed budgets implemented.
items.remaining_acceptance: Review schema migration with all loading consumers.

items.title: Produce the complete component ledger
items.candidate_progress: 80 estimated components close 600 kilogram base and 98 kilogram wheel budgets.
items.remaining_acceptance: Approve allocation evidence and calibration; estimates are not measurements.

items.title: Establish estimation ranges and evidence
items.candidate_progress: Per-component mass, center and tensor uncertainty recorded.
items.remaining_acceptance: Complete component-specific evidence and correlated physical uncertainty ranges.

items.title: Derive centers and full inertia tensors
items.candidate_progress: Component-local centers and full symmetric physical inertia tensors contribute to the candidate.
items.remaining_acceptance: Verify full geometry trajectories, centers, sensitivity and aggregate tensors over the operating domain.

items.title: Integrate fuel mass properties and exchange
items.candidate_progress: Analytical fuel energy and momentum exchange preserves velocities; candidate consumption uses physical event duration.
items.remaining_acceptance: Complete fuel-range handling and integrated refuel acceptance.

items.title: Migrate loading and reconcile status records
items.candidate_progress: Base and livery manifests select and hash the geometric profile; eight geometric tests pass.
items.remaining_acceptance: Complete all compatibility loaders and reconcile historical records.

items.title: Validate hardpoints and full operating envelopes
items.candidate_progress: Rear damper upper-skin clearance passes with assumed radius; travel and motion ratio regressions pass.
items.remaining_acceptance: Perform full finite-volume sweeps against lower shell, gearbox, shafts and adjacent members across travel and steering.

items.title: Verify component poses and spatial derivatives
items.candidate_progress: Moving component frames and numerical spatial derivatives feed the candidate.
items.remaining_acceptance: Validate full derivative envelopes, convergence, finite-difference scales and geometric branch continuity.

items.title: Assemble the production coupled mass matrix
items.candidate_progress: Fourteen-coordinate symmetric positive definite matrix includes component and wheel spin cross terms.
items.remaining_acceptance: Complete production comparison, generalized eigenvalue and full-state conditioning gates.

items.title: Integrate orientation and rotating inertia
items.candidate_progress: Quaternion orientation, transported tensors, aligned rotors and gyroscopic terms implemented.
items.remaining_acceptance: Complete spinning rotor and prescribed steering energy convergence over the whole domain.

items.title: Project suspension forces from mechanical work
items.candidate_progress: Spring, damper, antiroll and stops use generalized mechanical work.
items.remaining_acceptance: Complete force derivative and combined-load energy validation.

items.title: Resolve travel limits as mechanical events
items.candidate_progress: Localized travel crossings and generalized velocity projection implemented.
items.remaining_acceptance: Unify braking, travel and collision constraints and validate all simultaneous crossings.

items.title: Recover physical joint and mounting loads
items.candidate_progress: Legacy filtered reaction outputs still exist.
items.remaining_acceptance: Recover physical joint and mount forces from dynamic component acceleration and constraint reactions.

items.title: Couple wheel spin, braking, and drivetrain reactions
items.candidate_progress: Coupled drive reaction and bounded wheel braking implemented; thermal energy uses resolved work.
items.remaining_acceptance: Implement complete engine, shaft and clutch rotational momentum and energy; validate simultaneous constraints.

items.title: Connect the existing tire model to actual contact motion
items.candidate_progress: Existing tire force path receives actual hub velocities, supported loads and solved wheel alignment.
items.remaining_acceptance: Complete footprint queries, pressure-dependent vertical stiffness, deflection diagnostics and slip work validation.

items.title: Project aerodynamic and remaining external forces
items.candidate_progress: Existing aero and external wrench adapted to body origin with five Rust probes.
items.remaining_acceptance: Validate actual ground reconstruction, all external force work and remaining consumer diagnostics.

items.title: Introduce an authoritative Rust simulation world
items.candidate_progress: Shared Rust clock, entities, timestamped inputs and atomic rejected steps implemented.
items.remaining_acceptance: Complete integration ownership and supported dynamic world state.

items.title: Select and implement the production integrator
items.candidate_progress: Candidate semi-implicit advancement and event localization implemented.
items.remaining_acceptance: Select production method and frequency using convergence, passivity and measured race cost.

items.title: Establish the complete pre-collision reference benches
items.candidate_progress: Analytical matrix, spin, braking, fuel and contact benches implemented.
items.remaining_acceptance: Execute the complete pre-collision validation matrix and joint-load benches.

items.title: Evaluate and select the geometric detection library
items.candidate_progress: Parry 0.23.0 pinned for candidate geometric queries.
items.remaining_acceptance: Complete library selection review, license and required feature/maintenance coverage.

items.title: Prepare and import the physical world geometry
items.candidate_progress: Fuji physical package preserves transformed geometry, roles, surfaces and source/geometry hashes.
items.remaining_acceptance: Validate all geometry coverage, surface grouping and production promotion.

items.title: Define collision shapes for the articulated vehicle
items.candidate_progress: Estimated body boxes and solved wheel cylinders implemented.
items.remaining_acceptance: Validate authored shape fidelity, finite bounds and articulated attachments.

items.title: Implement world queries and candidate filtering
items.candidate_progress: Rust rays, overlap/contact queries and swept bounding volume filtering implemented.
items.remaining_acceptance: Implement scalable world broad phase and validate all road and collision query domains.

items.title: Maintain stable persistent contact manifolds
items.candidate_progress: Candidate constraints are rebuilt cold each solve; entity-based contact identities are stable.
items.remaining_acceptance: Implement feature-based persistent manifolds, cache lifecycle and warm starting.

items.title: Solve normal impulses with the generalized vehicle matrix
items.candidate_progress: Generalized effective-mass normal response and restitution tests pass.
items.remaining_acceptance: Complete persistent simultaneous-contact, travel and brake response gates.

items.title: Solve tangential impact friction and rotational effects
items.candidate_progress: Projected friction disk with coupled tangential effective masses and passivity checks implemented.
items.remaining_acceptance: Complete material pairing, rotating impacts, resting friction and full passivity matrix.

items.title: Add continuous collision detection and event localization
items.candidate_progress: Translation/rotation casts and atomic impact re-advancement implemented.
items.remaining_acceptance: Bound articulated trajectory error and validate tunneling and simultaneous event convergence.

items.title: Classify contacts and prevent duplicate response
items.candidate_progress: Wheel tread support excludes selected vertical curb triangles from compliant support handling.
items.remaining_acceptance: Validate composite curb meshes, feature remapping, slopes and duplicate response classification.

items.title: Solve vehicle-to-vehicle contact in one world step
items.candidate_progress: All candidate vehicles solve shared contact constraints in one Rust world.
items.remaining_acceptance: Complete multi-car impact, pileup, identity/removal and energy benchmarks.

items.title: Define dynamic world-object interoperability
items.candidate_progress: Unsupported moving nonvehicle prescribed contact motion is rejected.
items.remaining_acceptance: Define and implement ownership, momentum exchange and lifecycle for supported dynamic world objects.

items.title: Stabilize persistent contacts and rest states
items.candidate_progress: Bounded position correction has a separate energy ledger.
items.remaining_acceptance: Implement stable resting manifolds, warm starts, static friction and mesh-seam validation.

items.title: Define a versioned native world interface
items.candidate_progress: Native world loader, full source parity gate, owned response buffers and close/removal lifecycle exercised with freshly compiled isolated libraries.
items.remaining_acceptance: Rebuild and validate the complete production extension and canonical game runtime.

items.title: Replace the force-host loop with a single world step
items.candidate_progress: Opt-in Godot controller queues all vehicle inputs then advances one shared Rust world; native vehicle proxies are frozen with collision layers, masks and gravity disabled. Two-vehicle native smoke passes.
items.remaining_acceptance: Review the complete canonical scene and full race scheduling/performance; obtain human approval before default activation.

items.title: Implement lifecycle, reset, pause, and initialization
items.candidate_progress: Explicit scene bindings initialize the world; native refuel, tire replacement, requested-pose reset, pause and vehicle removal pass in the isolated two-vehicle Godot harness.
items.remaining_acceptance: Validate late session recomposition, pit-stop animation and the full gameplay lifecycle in the canonical race scene.

items.title: Render the solved mechanical state
items.candidate_progress: Rust snapshots publish four solved corners. Godot renders hub, wheel spin, wishbones, pushrod, rocker, damper and driveshaft from authoritative endpoints without a second suspension solve. Native harness checks hub/damper agreement and zero linkage solves.
items.remaining_acceptance: Validate interpolation, full authored vehicle appearance and all mechanical packaging volumes through human visual review.

items.title: Deliver telemetry and collision events to existing consumers
items.candidate_progress: Existing CoreFrame telemetry and sampler consume physical systems snapshots without advancing legacy simulation; native wheel surface/load/spin getters are mirrored; collision events are signaled and routed to impact audio. Sampler output is finite and nonzero.
items.remaining_acceptance: Validate audible contact transitions, sustained scraping, controller feedback, HUD consumers and all collision event classes in the full game.

items.title: Preserve gameplay and configuration consumers
items.candidate_progress: Profile paths are checked across physical/presentation owners; per-vehicle input and aids are sampled; refuel/tire/reset services route to Rust; unsupported runtime tuning is rejected rather than applied to the shadow simulator.
items.remaining_acceptance: Complete runtime tuning transport, pit animation, cameras and all configuration/editor consumers; validate session recomposition.

items.title: Add explicit activation and compatibility gates
items.candidate_progress: Both F1 2030 test session variants have an inactive world controller. Canonical launcher accepts an explicit PhysicalWorldPackage parameter; native loader rejects BUILD disagreement and incompatible/missing symbols; unregistered moving Godot bodies are rejected.
items.remaining_acceptance: Complete production rebuild, canonical scene smoke, performance/compatibility gates and human acceptance; keep default owner unchanged until approved.

items.title: Execute the complete contact and impact matrix
items.candidate_progress: Selected analytical contact, friction, braking, energy and timestamp tests pass.
items.remaining_acceptance: Execute complete world geometry, impacts, rest, curb, travel and multi-car acceptance matrix.

items.title: Validate replay and standalone/runtime parity
items.candidate_progress: Host cadence determinism test passes inside the Rust candidate.
items.remaining_acceptance: Implement native/Godot replay parity, recorded inputs and cross-host-step equivalence.

items.title: Quantify physical uncertainty and timestep sensitivity
items.candidate_progress: Budget-constrained mass variants preserve 600 kilogram base and each declared wheel assembly; tensors scale consistently.
items.remaining_acceptance: Execute correlated center/tensor uncertainty and timestep sensitivity scenarios against integrated parity.

items.title: Measure race cost and optimize without changing physics
items.candidate_progress: Short 32-car sample fails real-time target; isolated kernel profiler implemented.
items.remaining_acceptance: Optimize verified geometry/matrix bottlenecks and measure racing median/tail costs on all authored grid spots.

items.title: Calibrate the complete physical vehicle
items.candidate_progress: Fictional provisional component data only.
items.remaining_acceptance: Calibrate ride, tire behavior, handling, reaction loads and contact response against declared targets.

items.title: Produce a clean source-matched runtime build
items.candidate_progress: Installed DLLs and BUILD_SOURCE preserved; candidate builds stay in task-owned scratch.
items.remaining_acceptance: Complete clean Cargo/SCons/Godot rebuild, dirty-source fingerprint parity and canonical launcher verification.

items.title: Perform integrated driving and visual review
items.candidate_progress: Upper damper skin test completed; no integrated driving review.
items.remaining_acceptance: Execute source-matched native smoke, Fuji driving, rear geometry visual review and obtain human review.

items.title: Audit delivery and prepare atomic publication
items.candidate_progress: Protected provenance and per-item candidate execution records exist.
items.remaining_acceptance: Audit all prior gates, review explicit atomic change scope and prepare publication only after approval.
